sources.title: NEB T7 Expression
sources.support: A target coding sequence is placed downstream of its promoter, and an expression host supplies the relevant RNA polymerase.

sources.title: NEB host compatibility FAQ
sources.support: The specified ordinary NEBExpress host cannot express T7-promoter constructs; an appropriate T7 expression host is recommended. This supplies a concrete compatibility example, not a universal on/off law.

sources.title: Promega S30 T7 technical manual TM306, sections 1 and 3.A
sources.support: The system provides transcription machinery and translation components. Promoter compatibility is one requirement; template context, ribosome binding and other conditions can affect expression.
